diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the nasopharynx
legend: The neoplasm diffusely replaces the mucosa. Normal epithelium is present at the top of the field.

diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the nasopharynx
legend: Large centroblasts and some centrocytes replace normal tissue.

diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the nasopharynx
legend: The neoplasm is strongly positive for CD20, supporting a B-cell lineage.

diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the tonsil
legend: The neoplasm diffusely replaces the tonsillar parenchyma. Squamous epithelium from the surface of the tonsil is also present in the field.

diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the tonsil
legend: Oil magnification showing the centroblastic features of the lymphoma cells. Histiocytes and mitotic figures are also present in the field.

diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the tonsil
legend: The lymphoma cells are strongly positive for IRF4 (MUM1), and CD10 was negative (not shown), supporting a non–germinal-centre B-cell immunophenotype.

diagnosis: Salivary gland diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
legend: The parotid salivary gland demonstrates sheets of neoplastic lymphoid cells, with a background of necrosis. The neoplastic cells are large, with irregular nuclei and a high N:C ratio.
